article.name: 文章配图
article.notes: Single clear idea per image, generous margins, readable at article width.

wechat-cover.name: 公众号封面
wechat-cover.notes: Ultra-wide cover: keep the focal subject in the central 60% so a square thumbnail crop still works; calm background.

xiaohongshu.name: 小红书配图（竖版）
xiaohongshu.notes: Vertical card for a feed: one strong focal point in the upper two thirds, clear visual hierarchy, keep a clean band at the top or bottom for a title added later.

xiaohongshu-square.name: 小红书封面（方形）
xiaohongshu-square.notes: Square cover: centred focal point with even margins.

x-cover.name: X 封面
x-cover.notes: Wide banner; the profile photo covers the lower left, so keep the left-bottom area quiet.

video-cover.name: 视频封面（YouTube / B 站 横版）
video-cover.notes: Thumbnail logic: one huge readable focal subject, high contrast, simple background, readable when shrunk to 320 px wide. Leave a clear area (left or bottom third) where a title can be laid on later.

video-vertical.name: 竖屏视频封面 / 海报（抖音·视频号·Reels）
video-vertical.notes: Full-screen vertical. Keep important content inside the central safe area: about 12% free at the top and 20% at the bottom for app UI and captions.

poster.name: 海报
poster.notes: Poster hierarchy: one iconic focal element, limited palette, strong negative space.

movie-poster.name: 电影海报
movie-poster.notes: Conceptual reinterpretation, not a literal scene; silhouettes and symbols over faces.

book-cover.name: 书籍封面
book-cover.notes: Trade book proportions; leave room for title and author lettering to be added later.

album-cover.name: 专辑封面
album-cover.notes: Square; must stay striking at 120 px.

moments.name: 朋友圈海报
moments.notes: Shared as a tall card in a feed: a single idea, bold shapes, safe margins.

paper.name: 论文 / 科普配图
paper.notes: Explanatory editorial illustration; wit over detail.
